decisions.reason: Changing the requalification task to one reference-matching clip does not remove or modify the general requirement for effective hooks.
The source changes the number and reference basis of the requalification submission but does not alter the complete, educational, standalone-moment standard.
The candidate already has a complete message-143 MODIFY changing the task from two remaining revisions to one reference-matching clip; no additional update or removal is required.
The source concerns the later requalification task and does not retroactively change the completed initial three-clip trial.
The one-clip reference task is part of requalification and does not modify the separate extended trial batch.
The source does not change the existing caption color, font, or effects requirements.
The source changes the requalification submission count and reference but says nothing about the required clip-duration range.
Matching the supplied reference for one clip does not necessarily alter the existing clean-editing and effects policy.
The task-local requalification change does not alter the separate monthly production quota of 125 approved clips.
